Priya (Sales): Heads up: Meridian Health RFI due Monday EOD. They want a capability matrix, a 14-day PoC quote, network diagram, answers to sec questionnaire sections 2.1/3.5/6.2, and explicit burst guarantees.
Lena (Eng-ML): Quick clarifying q — when they say "burst" do they mean concurrent sessions or qps? Any sample traffic profile?
Priya (Sales): They provided a profile: baseline ~150 concurrent, spikes to ~600 qps for ~20s every hour. Target p95 <180ms for 1500-token generation on gen endpoint. Also asked about FP16/INT8 and KV caching semantics.
Noah (Eng-Platform): Operationally we can meet that with Dedicated + autoscale. Recommend reserving baseline pool for steady traffic and allowing burst autoscale with automatic fallback to hosted quantized variant when Dedicated is at capacity. Will add routing/fallback notes.
Carmen (Security): HSM/KMS: support for customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For on-prem HSM, Private deployment supports PKCS#11. Audit logs: we can provide immutable audit logs and retention up to 12 months on enterprise plan. I'll draft answers for sec 2.1 and 3.5.
Toby (Finance): Very rough PoC numbers: reserved baseline approx $2,200/day; autoscale incremental cost ~ $0.50/min when bursting. For the 2-week PoC with the stated spike pattern expect ~$35k-$45k. I'll produce a per-line cost table for the matrix.
Lena (Eng-ML): I'll draft the capability matrix layout: rows = feature, latency SLO, model variants & quantization, KV/prefix caching behavior, routing & fallback, telemetry & tracing, audit retention, KMS/HSM. Filename: meridian_capmatrix_v1.xlsx (will attach).
Priya (Sales): We also need a network diagram with VPC peering, allowed egress ports, and whether we need private peering vs public endpoints. Also require signed NDA before detailed infra configs. Carmen, which legal contact should I use?
Carmen (Security): Legal contact: legal@redwood.com. Use NDA template v4. Also mention TLS mutual auth for peering and that we support custom egress IP ranges.
file-bot: Uploaded /files/meridian/network-sketch-v2.png
Noah (Eng-Platform): Uploaded preflight `poc-preflight-checklist.md` and a short terraform example for peering and routes.
Priya (Sales): Perfect — once Lena posts the matrix I'll merge costs & security answers into the RFI response and send draft to Meridian Friday AM. Thanks team :raised_hands:
